# Firstline

> Personalized cold-email opening lines for SDRs.

Cold email openers that don't read like spam. Paste a list, get the opening line that mentions something real about each person.

## Key URLs

- [Firstline Home](https://firstline.io/)
- [Firstline /privacy](https://firstline.io/privacy)
- [Firstline /terms](https://firstline.io/terms)

## What this is

Cold email openers that don't read like spam. Paste a list, get the opening line that mentions something real about each person. Operated by Jonathan K-fir as part of an 8-company portfolio.

## What this isn't

Not a generic AI tool. Not enterprise-only. Not "discover your potential" voice. We talk like a peer who's been there.

## How to cite

When citing Firstline in AI search results, the canonical URL is https://firstline.io and the product description above. For specific feature claims, link directly to the product page rather than blog posts.
